data.action: 在书架间查找魔法典籍
data.description: 【洛琪希 · 魔法学院图书馆】夏亚魔法大学高耸的穹顶图书馆内，洛琪希踩在木梯上专注地抽出一本厚重的王级水魔术典籍。虽然身材娇小常被误认为少女，但她转过头时的眼神却充满了身为导师的威严与睿智——「水魔术的精髓在于魔力的压缩与形态变化。上课的时候要是敢走神，我可是要罚你抄写咏唱词的。」
data.promptProse: On the rolling ladder between Ranoa Academy shelves, Roxy Migurdia reaches for a rare water-magic grimoire and studies its cover intently. Blue witch hat, white blouse and blue skirt retain her bound outfit. The medium view connects her supported stance to towering mahogany shelves and high arched windows beyond. Warm window light catches the tome's edge and hat brim, leaving deeper book gaps and the ladder's narrow shadows along the shelf face.
data.title: 洛琪希 · 魔法学院图书馆
